title: USC Trojans Hoodie Varsity Athletic Color Yellow Size M 80/20 Used
descriptionText:
Used but still in great shape. One minor defect on the sleeve, looks like some small splotches of paint. See pics.

Show off your team spirit with this vibrant yellow USC Trojans hoodie. Perfect for any athletic occasion, this pullover style hoodie is designed with an athletic fit for maximum comfort. Made by M & M, this hoodie is a great addition to any activewear collection. The colorful theme adds a touch of personality to your outfit, making it a must-have for any fan of the Trojans. Available in size M, this hoodie is a great choice for any man looking to support his favorite team in style.
